Class RandomSamples

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.RandomSamples
public final class RandomSamples extends Object
Samples: several different elements taken at random among other ones, without taking any twice. 
RandomSamples.sample(players, 3, random);                         // three different players
RandomSamples.weightedSample(prizes, Prize::tickets, 3, random);  // three different prizes, by weight
lines.collect(RandomSamples.toSample(100, random));               // 100 lines of a stream of any length

A sample has fewer elements than asked for when there aren't enough to take. An element that occurs several times may be taken as many times.

Since:
0.2.0

  • Method Details

    • sample

      public static <T> List<T> sample(Collection<? extends T> elements, int count, RandomGenerator random)
      Takes elements of a collection, each set of elements with the same chance.

      It calls RandomGenerator.nextInt(int) once per element taken, with the number of elements that are left to take from.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the elements
      Parameters:
      elements - the elements to take from
      count - how many elements to take
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      the elements taken, in a random order: count of them, or all of them if there are fewer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if count is negative

    • weightedSample

      public static <T> List<T> weightedSample(Collection<? extends T> elements, ToDoubleFunction<? super T> weight, int count, RandomGenerator random)
      Takes elements of a collection one after the other, each time with chances proportional to the weights of the elements that are left. An element whose weight is zero is never taken.

      It calls RandomGenerator.nextDouble() once per element whose weight is positive, in the iteration order of the collection.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the elements
      Parameters:
      elements - the elements to take from
      weight - the function that gives the weight of an element
      count - how many elements to take
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      the elements taken, in the order they were taken: count of them, or all those with a positive weight if there are fewer
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if count is negative, or if a weight is negative, infinite or not a number

    • toSample

      public static <T> Collector<T,?,List<T>> toSample(int count, RandomGenerator random)
      Returns a collector that takes elements of a stream, each set of elements with the same chance, without knowing how many elements the stream has and while keeping only the sample in memory.

      Past the first count elements, it uses the source of randomness only for the elements it takes, which get rarer as the stream goes on. Which methods it calls isn't specified.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the elements
      Parameters:
      count - how many elements to take
      random - the source of randomness
      Returns:
      a collector of the elements taken, in no particular order: count of them, or all of them if the stream has fewer. It doesn't support parallel streams.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if count is negative
